questions.promptText: As shown in the figure, a uniform electric field in the horizontal direction exists on a horizontal tabletop. A small object of mass m = 0.1 kg and charge Q = -2.0 x 10-n C is placed at point O on the tabletop and released from rest. Given that the sliding friction force between the object and the tabletop is f = 0.2 N, and the electric force acting on the object is F = 0.4 N directed to the right.Then, the work done by the net external forces on the object within 2 seconds after release from rest is ( ).
questions.explanation: B 1 Net force: F_net = 0.4 N - 0.2 N = 0.2 N (to the right). 2 Acceleration: a = F_net/m = 0.2/0.1 = 2 m/s^2. 3 Delta K after 2 s: v = at = 4 m/s => Delta K = (1/2) m v^2 = 0.8 J. 4 Work by net external force equals Delta K = 0.8 J.
